title: Extraction and Mapping Architecture Audit + Modern OpenAI-Only Redesign Plan
scope: Planning and audit only. No production extraction, mapping, XBRL generation, Arelle, frontend, backend route, database schema, or job-data behavior changed.

scope_guard.job_9_policy: Job 9 is downgraded to a smoke-test regression sample only and must not be used as the primary benchmark or ground truth for the next architecture.

upload_and_job_creation.summary: routers/filings.py accepts PDF uploads, creates a FilingJob row, stores the uploaded PDF path, and starts process_pdf_task asynchronously.

pdf_processing_orchestration.summary: tasks.py process_pdf_task opens an async session and delegates PDF processing to SmartAIProcessor.process_pdf.

page_classification.summary: SmartAIProcessor first tries text/layout heading classification. If that fails, Stage1Classifier calls the OpenAI vision path when MODEL_PROVIDER=openai. Legacy Hugging Face client construction remains outside OpenAI mode only.

stage_2_extraction.summary: For each classified page, SmartAIProcessor builds a multi-template Stage 2 prompt, calls OpenAI text extraction when native text quality is sufficient, then falls back to region VLM and whole-page VLM extraction. The prompt asks the model to extract values and assign template_code/concept_id in one step.

template_and_concept_matching.summary: The current mapping path first accepts a model-supplied concept_id if it belongs to the selected template and passes narrow guardrails. If not, it uses XBRLTemplateService.find_matching_concept_hybrid, which currently behaves as string/template matching in OpenAI mode because live Hugging Face embeddings are disabled and the new semantic_embeddings store is not yet used by production matching.

embedding_state.new_shadow_store: semantic_embeddings contains OpenAI text-embedding-3-large vectors for template_service_concept records, but production matcher behavior is unchanged.
embedding_state.latest_backfill_finding: reports/openai_embedding_generation_20260505T135131Z.json reported 1313 source records and would_generate=0 after full backfill.

persistence.summary: Extracted rows persist page linkage, extracted_label, extracted_value, confidence, statement_type, template_field_id, confirmed_tag_id, review flags, current/previous-year values, and validation warning flags. The model does not persist bounding boxes, source text spans, or table-cell coordinates.

xbrl_generation.summary: XBRL generation loads reviewed rows with either confirmed_tag_id or template_field_id, and download generation can include unreviewed rows. confirmed_tag_id takes precedence; otherwise template_field_id becomes the XBRL concept name. Guardrails are rechecked before fact creation.

validation.summary: xbrl_validator.py performs readiness validation and treats either confirmed_tag_id or template_field_id as mapping evidence. arelle_validator.py wraps deterministic Arelle CLI validation and local schemaRef handling; it is not an LLM tool-call loop.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Classification uses a text heuristic first and OpenAI vision fallback only when text cues are insufficient. Pages with continuation sections, mixed statements, or weak headings can enter extraction with partial or wrong template context.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Rows appear under the wrong statement tab or remain unmatched because the wrong template list was supplied.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Native text is passed directly into a broad prompt that asks for extraction and template/concept assignment. Layout, columns, and table boundaries are not represented as a stable intermediate model.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Multi-year values can be missed, assigned to the wrong year, or duplicated when page text loses table shape.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Region and whole-page VLM fallback handles both visual extraction and mapping context. Visual model output can vary across retries and lacks persisted source-cell evidence.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Inconsistent row counts, missing values, duplicated table rows, or changed concept assignments across runs.

instability_findings.why_unstable: The current pipeline extracts text/layout blocks but does not persist a table candidate model with row, column, bbox, and source text spans before invoking LLM normalization.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Rows can look correct as text but lose column/year association in the review UI and XBRL facts.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Year assignment is model-provided and later cleaned only as scalar year metadata. There is no deterministic column model tying current/prior-year values to table headers.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Current-year and previous-year values may be swapped, omitted, or duplicated.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Extraction, calculation warning detection, and concept mapping happen after the model already emitted rows. There is no explicit row_type model separating line item, subtotal, total, note heading, and narrative rows before mapping.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Subtotals can map to broad total concepts or duplicated summary facts.

instability_findings.why_unstable: The prompt instructs parentheses-as-negative, but normalization is not separated into a deterministic evidence-backed stage with raw_value, normalized_value, sign_source, and confidence.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Losses, contra-assets, or cash outflows can be stored with wrong sign or ambiguous formatting.

instability_findings.why_unstable: statement_type depends on classification and template selection in the same extraction pass. Wrong template_code fallback can propagate into context selection for XBRL generation.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Facts may use an instant/duration context inconsistent with the source statement.

instability_findings.why_unstable: The model is asked to extract visible data and map to exact XBRL concept IDs at the same time. This makes it hard to distinguish extraction failure from mapping failure.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: A row can look extracted but be silently attached to the wrong concept, making review and debugging harder.

instability_findings.why_unstable: String/template matching can prefer broad concepts when source labels are short or company-specific. Existing biological asset and receivables guardrails are useful but narrow.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Specific rows can be mapped to broad summary concepts, producing misleading XBRL facts.

instability_findings.why_unstable: ExtractedDataItem stores page linkage and labels/values but not source text spans, table cell coordinates, bbox, or evidence excerpts.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Reviewers cannot easily verify why a value or mapping was chosen from the source document.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Page image paths are stored, but row-level source regions are not stored. Region VLM crops are transient.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: The UI cannot highlight the exact source row/cell supporting an extracted fact.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Confidence is a mixture of model output, accepted LLM concept_id, and string/semantic score buckets. It is not calibrated against benchmark outcomes.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Rows may be marked reviewed/high-confidence even when evidence is thin.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Prior Job 9 work was a smoke-test path and is not representative enough to drive architecture decisions.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Fixes can improve one sample while harming other statement formats.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Job 9 duplicate/mapping observations are useful but too narrow. Designing around Job 9 alone would bias the pipeline toward arbitrary smoke-test data.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Regression risk on Job 11 and real customer-like filings.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Text, region VLM, and whole-page VLM fallback paths can all produce the same final item shape without a persisted provenance model.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Two runs can differ but the review UI cannot explain which extraction route produced a row.

instability_findings.why_unstable: Readiness validation and Arelle structural checks do not prove MBRS/FS-MPERS submission readiness or mapping correctness. Arelle reports structural issues but cannot infer correct mappings from source evidence.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: A downloadable package can still require human review and mapping validation.

instability_findings.why_unstable: The current review flow can edit/save rows and confirmed_tag_id, but it does not yet expose top-k mapping suggestions, guardrail reasons, evidence snippets, or confidence rationale as first-class review objects.
instability_findings.user_visible_symptom: Reviewers see extracted rows but lack enough context to confidently accept or reject mappings at scale.

keep.reason: It provides the needed human review surface and should be extended later with evidence and top-k suggestions rather than replaced now.
It centralizes OpenAI text, vision, structured JSON, and embedding access with key redaction and testable helpers.
It supports provider-versioned OpenAI embeddings side-by-side with legacy vector(1752) columns and enables shadow comparison.
They are the active local taxonomy/template source used by prompts, review, and current string/template matching.
It is a deterministic validation/reporting layer and should remain separate from LLM mapping decisions.
Existing biological asset and receivables guardrails are useful examples of evidence-based automatic mapping controls.

replace_or_redesign.component: LLM prompt that combines extraction and concept mapping
replace_or_redesign.reason: It couples two failure modes and allows model-assigned concepts to enter the persistence path too early.
Vision should be used for scanned pages and ambiguous layout, not as an opaque equivalent to text/table extraction when native structure exists.
It can map short or company-specific labels to broad concepts without enough evidence.
Industrial review and audit need source snippets, page regions, table column/year, and route provenance.

recommended_architecture.name: Hybrid industrial pipeline: text/table-first extraction, OpenAI structured normalization, embedding-assisted mapping suggestions, deterministic validation, and human acceptance
required_assets: local Python PDF/rendering tooling already present

layers.name: Document ingestion and evidence model
layers.design: Store raw PDF page metadata, native text, rendered image path when needed, page number, extraction route, source text snippets, and future bbox/table-cell coordinates.

layers.name: Document structure detection
layers.design: Detect statement sections, notes, table boundaries, year columns, statement titles, and continuation pages. Use OpenAI only for ambiguous section/layout reasoning, outputting strict JSON.

layers.name: Deterministic table candidate extraction
layers.design: Extract candidate rows before mapping: raw_label, raw_value, year, column_name, page_number, statement_section, source_text/evidence, route, and confidence.

layers.name: OpenAI structured normalization
layers.design: Use OpenAI structured output to clean labels, normalize numbers, detect negative signs, classify row_type, identify totals/subtotals, and return confidence with a concise reasoning summary. Do not invent values.

layers.name: Mapping candidate generation
layers.design: Generate top-k candidates using local template rules, string matching, and OpenAI embeddings from semantic_embeddings. Apply guardrails before any auto-acceptance.

layers.name: Mapping decision policy
layers.design: Separate auto-accepted mappings, suggested mappings, unmapped rows, and guardrail-blocked rows. Store decision reasons and confidence. Preserve confirmed_tag_id as manual confirmation while considering a future accepted_mapping record.

layers.name: XBRL generation
layers.design: Generate XBRL only from accepted mappings. Keep unmapped/suggested rows out of final XBRL unless manually confirmed or policy-accepted with evidence.

layers.name: Validation and audit
layers.design: Run readiness validation, Arelle instance_baseline, and generated XBRL audit. Produce human-readable issue reports. Do not use Arelle as an automatic LLM remapping loop.

layers.name: Human review loop
layers.design: Show extracted row, evidence, source page/region, top-k mapping suggestions, guardrail reason, confidence, and accept/reject/change mapping actions.

use_for: page/section classification when native text is weak
table-boundary reasoning when local extraction cannot recover structure
do_not_use_for: primary extraction engine when native text/table extraction is adequate
direct final concept assignment without local candidate validation

use_for: strict JSON section classification from text evidence
constraints: do not map to XBRL taxonomy inside extraction prompts

use_for: embedding query for normalized row text plus statement context
do_not_use_for: destructive replacement of legacy vector columns

reliability_controls: bounded retries for model transport or schema errors
evidence requirement for every extracted row
no-invention rule in prompts and validators
confidence thresholds calibrated on a multi-PDF benchmark
manual review threshold for low/medium confidence or guardrail-blocked mappings

arelle_position.recommendation: Arelle should remain deterministic validation and reporting now. Do not build an agentic LLM auto-fix or auto-remap loop yet.
safe_later_use: LLM summarizes Arelle issues into product-friendly categories
LLM links Arelle messages to affected facts or templates when evidence is available
LLM proposes remediation categories for a human reviewer
never_automate_without_human_approval: automatic generated-XBRL rewrites based only on LLM interpretation of Arelle messages

option_comparison.option: Option 1: Keep current VLM+LLM mixed pipeline and patch it
option_comparison.assessment: Useful only for short-term bug fixes. It does not address extraction/mapping coupling or evidence traceability.

option_comparison.option: Option 2: Text-first / table-first extraction with OpenAI normalization
option_comparison.evidence_traceability: high if source spans are stored
option_comparison.assessment: Strong base, but needs a fallback for scanned or layout-complex pages.

option_comparison.option: Option 3: OpenAI vision-first extraction for all pages
option_comparison.evidence_traceability: medium unless bbox/source evidence is added
option_comparison.mbrs_mpers_suitability: acceptable for scanned pages, wasteful for native PDFs
option_comparison.assessment: Simple to reason about at the API level but too costly and opaque as the default.

option_comparison.speed: high for native PDFs, acceptable for fallback pages
option_comparison.assessment: Recommended. It separates extraction, normalization, mapping suggestions, mapping decisions, validation, and human review.

phases.name: Architecture approval and benchmark dataset definition
phases.objective: Approve the separation of extraction, normalization, mapping candidates, decisions, and validation.
success_criteria: Benchmark PDFs and metrics are defined
phases.rollback_strategy: No production changes; archive the plan if not accepted.

phases.name: Multi-PDF benchmark harness
phases.objective: Create reproducible extraction/mapping metrics across representative PDFs/jobs before changing the pipeline.
risks: Metric definitions that reward coverage over correctness
success_criteria: Row, value, year, sign, statement_type, mapping, XBRL, and validation metrics reported
phases.rollback_strategy: Benchmark scripts are read-only and can be disabled without touching production.

phases.name: New extraction prototype side-by-side
phases.objective: Run text/table-first candidate extraction beside current production output without DB cutover.
risks: Prototype accidentally writes to production tables
success_criteria: Side-by-side report compares current vs prototype rows

phases.name: OpenAI structured normalization prototype
phases.objective: Normalize candidate rows with strict JSON schemas and no taxonomy mapping.
phases.rollback_strategy: Disable normalization feature flag and retain current extraction path.

phases.name: Mapping candidate generation using OpenAI embeddings
phases.objective: Use semantic_embeddings for top-k suggestions in shadow mode only.
phases.rollback_strategy: Keep production matcher unchanged and ignore shadow suggestions.

phases.name: React review suggestions, no auto-commit
phases.objective: Expose evidence and top-k suggestions to reviewers without changing automatic mapping policy.
phases.rollback_strategy: Hide suggestion UI behind a feature flag.

phases.name: XBRL generation from accepted mappings only
phases.objective: Tighten generation policy so only accepted/confirmed mappings create final facts.
risks: Lower fact coverage until review workflow catches up
phases.rollback_strategy: Retain current generator path behind a compatibility flag during transition.

phases.name: Gradual production cutover behind feature flag
phases.objective: Run the new pipeline for selected PDFs/jobs after benchmark acceptance.
phases.rollback_strategy: Switch feature flag back to current production pipeline.

phases.name: Arelle-assisted issue summarization, not auto-fix
phases.objective: Summarize deterministic Arelle reports for reviewers without automatic remapping or DB mutation.
phases.rollback_strategy: Disable summaries and show raw deterministic reports.

benchmark_plan.job_9_policy: Job 9 is not the primary benchmark. It may remain only as a smoke-test regression sample because its original data was arbitrary and earlier duplicate groups are not safe as architecture ground truth.
minimum_dataset: scanned or image-heavy PDF if available
one real or near-real customer-like PDF
recommended_jobs: Job 11 where OpenAI extraction completed and Review Workspace displayed rows
new representative jobs created from the benchmark PDFs
benchmark_plan.success_condition: Architecture changes should improve correctness and traceability across multiple PDFs, not just increase fact count or optimize one smoke job.

risks.risk: Moving directly to semantic matcher cutover without a benchmark could increase broad mappings.
risks.mitigation: Run shadow top-k comparison before auto-acceptance.

risks.risk: Vision-first extraction could increase cost and lower debuggability.
risks.mitigation: Use native text/table extraction first and reserve vision for scanned or ambiguous pages.

risks.risk: Arelle output could be misused as an automatic remapping signal.
risks.mitigation: Keep Arelle deterministic and advisory; require human approval for mapping changes.

risks.risk: Fact coverage can drop when generation is restricted to accepted mappings.
risks.mitigation: Introduce accepted/suggested/unmapped states and benchmark review burden before production cutover.

next_feature_recommendation.reason: The architecture audit finds the next safest step is benchmark measurement, not another production pipeline change. A multi-PDF benchmark harness is required before side-by-side extraction or semantic matcher cutover can be judged.
